subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

Don't fight over such a __trivial__ issue.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Insignificant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"trivial"** means something that is of little value or importance; not worth much attention. (तुच्छ)

 
 
• **Example: **Don’t waste time arguing over trivial matters.
 
 
 
• **"Insignificant"** refers to something that is too small or unimportant to be worth consideration; it is synonymous with trivial. (अमहत्वपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **The errors in the report were insignificant and didn’t affect the overall conclusion.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **'trivial' **is **'insignificant'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Insignificant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Complex** (जटिल): Something that is not simple and has many interconnected parts or factors.

 
 
• **Example:** The complex machinery required specialized training to operate.
 
 
 
• **Controversial** (विवादास्पद): Something that causes disagreement or debate among people.
 
 
• **Example:** His controversial statement sparked a heated discussion.
 
 
 
• **Tricky** (चालाक या कठिन): Something that is difficult to do or deal with; requiring skill or care.
 
 
• **Example:** Solving the puzzle was tricky but rewarding.
